teaser: One is a life path built for standing at the front of a room, and an ISFP is a temperament built for stepping quietly out of it. Three songs into a band rehearsal, you are the one adjusting the amp without asking anyone's opinion, and also the one who would rather the whole thing be felt than explained. The 1 wants a clear direction and a name on the decision. The ISFP wants the decision to stay true to something felt rather than argued. The friction between leading and being left alone to make the thing right is the whole of this reading.
excerpt: A guitar case left open by the door, not yet put away.
